description: One derived JSON document: queried (components OSV answered in full), not_checked (with why: a distro package whose source name is unknown, a failed or truncated batch, an unreadable advisory), affected (purl, cve_id, osv_id) and unkeyed (advisories with no CVE alias). A not-checked component is never clean, and absence never retires its Claims. DRAFT: the derived Capture needs core lane B (c1-c6).
name: osv.match.result
